sections.section: ORDER - Laws (Continuance In Force Amendment) Order 1983
sections.description:
C
LAWS (CONTINUANCE
IN FORCE AMENDMENT) ORDER, 1983
C. M. L. A. ORDER 1
OF 1983
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 31st July, 1983]
No. F. 17(4)/83-Pub.-The
following C. M. L. A. Order made by the President is hereby published for
general information :--
In pursuance of the Proclamation
of the fifth day of July, 1977, and in exercise of all powers enabling him in
that behalf, the Chief Martial Law Administrator is pleased to make the
following Order :--
1. This Order may be
called the Laws (Continuance. is Force) (Fourteenth Amendment) Order, 1983.
2. In the Laws
(Continuance in Force) Order, 1977 (C. M. L. A, Order No. I of 1977), in
Article 2, in clause (1), in the Explanation; in paragraph (a), for the word
"ten" the word "eleven" shall be substituted.
